title: Adventurers Guild
tagline: SkyrimNet knowledge of the Adventurers Guild: its lore, its ranks, and your place in its ledger.
description:
Ships with the Adventurers Guild mod (AdventurersGuild.esp).

NPCs know the Guild's history and its troubles in Skyrim, each according to who they are: innkeepers who keep a Guild counter read your page of the ledger (rank, Reputation, reports waiting, how far you are from promotion); Companions, guards, soldiers, scholars and the Thalmor each know their side of the story. Guild ranks show on adventurers' bios, and your missives, dungeon clears and great kills become remembered events.

CONTENTS
knowledge/adventurers_guild_lore.sknpack  - the Guild's lore, targeted by faction
prompts/submodules/character_bio/0026_guild_rank.prompt  - guild rank, retired status, liaison duties and the player's ledger
prompts/submodules/guidelines/0511_guild_guidelines.prompt  - how ranks and the Guild work, for every NPC

The decorators (guild_rank_of, threat_rank_of, ag_player) and events come from AdventurersGuild.dll / AG_SkyrimNetInit.
author: adventurersguild
changelog: 1.8.0 (Adventurers Guild 1.2.0): what each rank is trusted with, from E to S (knowledge pack); the guild card (a liaison knows when yours is lost and what a replacement costs); notices from the hold notice boards as Guild work; parties of up to ten.
